# SunBot Robotics Programming STEAM Education

> Small-group robotics, coding and STEAM education for children in southwest Edmonton, Alberta, Canada.
> Programs are organized for ages 6-10 and 9-14. Classes are capped at six students.
> In regular class work each student usually has their own robotics kit; for major challenge
> projects and competitions students work in teams of 2-6.

This file is an experimental, informal summary of public pages. It is not required by any
search engine or AI provider. The authoritative sources are the HTML pages, robots.txt and
sitemap.xml.

## Important pages

- [Home](https://sunbotcanada.github.io/): Program overview, "at a glance" facts, southwest Edmonton service area.
- [Courses](https://sunbotcanada.github.io/courses.html): FLL Explore (ages 6-10) and FLL Challenge (ages 9-14) details, class structure, downloadable course poster.
- [Parent FAQ](https://sunbotcanada.github.io/faq.html): 70 questions covering starting age, beginners, LEGO SPIKE, robotics vs coding, class size, neighbourhoods and enrollment.
- [Parent Guide](https://sunbotcanada.github.io/parents-guide.html): Guide to choosing robotics classes for kids in Edmonton.
- [FLL Challenge](https://sunbotcanada.github.io/fll.html): FIRST LEGO League Challenge preparation.
- [About](https://sunbotcanada.github.io/about.html): Mission, differentiators, founder.
- [Gallery](https://sunbotcanada.github.io/gallery.html): Photos from classes and competition preparation.
- [Contact](https://sunbotcanada.github.io/contact.html): Email, Instagram, WeChat, Google Business Profile listing.

## Learning focus

Hands-on building, programming, engineering challenges, problem solving, teamwork,
presentations and project-based learning, using LEGO Education robotics kits.

## Service area

Southwest Edmonton, Alberta. Communities served include:

- Terwillegar and Riverbend area: Hodgson, Riverbend, Terwillegar Towne, Terwillegar
  Gardens, Magrath Heights, Haddow, Falconer Heights, Rhatigan Ridge, Brookview,
  Bulyea Heights, Ogilvie Ridge, Carter Crest, Grandview Heights
- Windermere and Keswick area: Windermere, Ambleside, Keswick, Langdale,
  Glenridding Heights, Glenridding Ravine
- Heritage Valley and Rutherford area: Rutherford, MacTaggart, Heritage Valley,
  Heritage Valley Town Centre, Chappelle, Desrochers, Allard, Cavanagh, Paisley,
  Graydon Hill
- South Edmonton: Ellerslie, Summerside

## Reviews

Parent reviews are published on the Google Business Profile listing
"SunBot Kids Robotics & STEM Education". This website does not republish review text.
